result.instructions: Tools for Glue Up, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our events start in the next 30 days, and are they published?"; "List the members of our directory whose company name starts with A."; "Which company memberships are in the software industry?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Glue Up data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run glueup_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run glueup_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run glueup_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. glueup_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: glueup_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List the organization's events with dates, venue and publication flags. Timestamps are epoch milliseconds. Filter by status (upcoming, ongoing, past), published / open-to-public flags, a start-date window or a title word. API: POST /event/list[/{status}].

search.description: A word in the event title.

published.description: Only published (true) or only unpublished (false) events.

open_to_public.description: Only events open to the public (true) or not (false).

starts_after.description: Only events starting at or after this ISO date, e.g. 2026-06-01.

starts_before.description: Only events starting at or before this ISO date.

language.description: Language code for translated texts, e.g. en.

fields.description: Properties to return (the API's projection); omit for the default set. Dotted names reach nested values.

field.description: Property name to filter on, e.g. status, featured, createdOn, industryCode, properties.<custom-field>.

operator.description: eq equal, ne not equal, gt/ge/lt/le comparisons, lk like, nl not like, bl null, nb not null, st starts with, ed ends with, in is in, any one of.

values.description: Values to compare with (an array, even for a single value).

offset.description: How many results to skip (default 0). The reply's total says how many exist.

order.description: Property to sort by, e.g. startDateTime (default) or title.

tools.name: glueup_list_members
tools.title: List directory members
tools.description: List the active people in the membership directory: name, company, position, membership type, start date, contact data and custom properties. Returns personal data. basic=true returns only the basic public fields. Search a name, email or company; filter by any property (featured, familyName, properties.<custom-field>...). API: POST /membershipDirectory/members[/basic].

tools.title: List industry codes

tools.name: glueup_get_directory_settings

tools.name: glueup_get_application_forms
tools.title: Get membership application forms
tools.description: Get the membership application forms: kind company or individual. all=false (default) returns the default form's items in listing order; all=true returns every form including custom ones, each with its items. API: GET /public/membership/{kind}ApplicationForm or POST /public/membership/{kind}ApplicationForms.

all.description: Every form including custom ones (default false: the default form only).

tools.name: glueup_list_application_form_fields
tools.title: List application form fields
tools.description: List every field of the company or individual membership application forms, including those of custom forms (keys, types, mandatory flags). API: GET /public/membership/{kind}ApplicationFormFields.

tools.name: glueup_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List the organization's finance invoices: number, currency, face total, balance due, purchaser, origin (e.g. EventTicket), voided flag and dates (epoch milliseconds). Filter by status (e.g. Overdue) or any property. Returns purchaser names and emails. API: POST /finance/invoice/list.
